The paper builds upon state-space models (SSMs) and aims to improve their expressivity by implementing non-linear state transitions, which relates to the linear-state recurrence category.
The paper demonstrates the model's capabilities on regular languages and natural language reasoning tasks, showing its utility for complex multi-step computation.
